question: As per the Government Budget 2022 - 23, what is the projected growth rate of the Indian economy for the financial year 2022 - 23?
solution:
The correct answer is __**0.092**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The projected growth rate of the Indian economy for the financial year 2022-23, as per the Government Budget 2022-23, is **0.092**.
 
• This growth rate projection is based on various economic indicators and assumptions made by the government and financial experts.
 
• The growth rate reflects the government's expectations for economic expansion and development during the fiscal year.
 
• Such projections are crucial for planning and policy-making, as they influence budget allocations, investment strategies, and economic reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Government Budget:**

 
 
• A government budget is an annual financial statement presenting the government's proposed revenues and spending for a financial year.
 
• It includes detailed estimates of the anticipated expenditures and expected revenues.
 
• The budget outlines the government's fiscal policy and economic priorities.
 
 
 
• **Projected Growth Rate:**
 
 
• The projected growth rate is an estimate of the rate at which a country’s economy is expected to grow within a specific period. 
 
 
• **Fiscal Year:**
 
 
• A fiscal year (FY) is a one-year period that governments use for accounting and budget purposes.
 
• It is different from a calendar year and can vary between countries.
 
• In India, the fiscal year runs from April 1 to March 31 of the following year.
 
 
 
• **Economic Indicators:**
 
 
• Economic indicators are statistical metrics used to gauge the health of an economy.
 
• They include metrics like GDP, unemployment rates, inflation rates, and more.
 
• These indicators help policymakers, investors, and analysts make informed decisions.
